logtarget.description: Log target for fail2ban messages (file, syslog, or /dev/stdout).

syslogsocket.description: Syslog socket path (e.g., /dev/log). Use 'auto' to auto-detect.

backend.description: File change detection backend: inotify, polling, or auto.

banaction.description: Default action to ban IPs (iptables-multiport, firewalld, nftables-multiport, etc.).

banaction_allports.description: Action used for jails matching all ports (e.g., sshd-allports).

findtime.description: Time window (seconds) during which maxretry failures trigger a ban.

bantime.description: Duration (seconds) an IP is banned by default.

bantime_increment.description: Enable exponential increase in ban time on repeat offenses.

bantime_rndtime.description: Random jitter (seconds) added to ban time to avoid synchronized resets.

bantime_maxtime.description: Maximum ban time (seconds) when using bantime_increment.

maxretry.description: Default number of failures before an IP is banned.

maxretry_local.description: Max retries for local IP addresses (often set lower for trusted networks).

action.description: Default action to perform on ban (e.g., action_mwl for mail+log).

jails.description: List of jail configurations. Each jail defines monitoring for a specific service (SSH, FTP, HTTP, etc.).

name.description: Unique identifier for the jail (e.g., sshd, proftpd, nginx-http-auth).

service.description: Human-readable service name for documentation (e.g., 'SSH server').

filter.description: Name of the filter file (without .conf suffix) that parses logs (e.g., 'sshd', 'nginx-http-auth').

logpath.description: Path(s) to log files to monitor. Supports wildcards (e.g., ['/var/log/auth.log']).

maxretry.description: Override global maxretry for this jail.

findtime.description: Override global findtime for this jail (seconds).

bantime.description: Override global bantime for this jail (seconds).

banaction.description: Override global banaction for this jail.

addaction.description: Additional action lines to append to the jail (e.g., 'action += %(action_mwl)s').

destemail.description: Email address for notifications (used by mail actions).

sendername.description: Name for the sender of ban notification emails.

datadir.description: Custom database path for fail2ban (for persistent state).

backend.description: Override global backend for this jail (e.g., 'pyinotify', 'polling').

protocol.description: Protocol for port filtering (tcp, udp, tcpudp).
